glyphs.canonicalName: bowl
glyphs.notes: Exact GNU Unifont U+006F lowercase o remap; all 128 pixels preserved. Native body occupies rows 6–13 and columns 1–6.

glyphs.canonicalName: open bowl
glyphs.notes: Exact GNU Unifont U+0063 lowercase c remap. The right aperture between the two native terminals remains open through rows 8–11.

glyphs.canonicalName: turned open bowl
glyphs.notes: Exact GNU Unifont U+0254 remap. Native open-o body and simple c-like terminals; no added weight on either free left terminal.

glyphs.canonicalName: stem
glyphs.notes: Exact GNU Unifont U+0131 DOTLESS I remap, including the two-pixel head at row 6, column-4 stave, and five-pixel foot at row 13. This corrects the former plain-bar starter.

glyphs.canonicalName: ascender
glyphs.notes: Exact GNU Unifont U+006C lowercase l remap: the dotless-i head moves to row 3, and the body and baseline foot remain unchanged.

glyphs.canonicalName: hook
glyphs.notes: Move the native lowercase-f hook one column right to the dotless-i axis: row 3 pixels (5,3) and (6,3), then column 4 from row 4. Omit f’s unrelated crossbar. Retain the complete dotless-i baseline foot at row 13, columns 2–6.

glyphs.canonicalName: descender
glyphs.notes: Retain the dotless-i head at (3,6) and (4,6). Continue the column-4 stave through row 14 and move the complete five-pixel dotless-i foot from row 13 to row 15; the straight descent has no baseline crossbar. Native p/q supply the two-row descender-depth precedent.

glyphs.canonicalName: long stem
glyphs.notes: Use lowercase l’s two-pixel head at row 3 and its column-4 vertical. Continue the column-4 stave through row 14 and move the complete five-pixel dotless-i foot from row 13 to row 15; the straight descent has no baseline crossbar. Native p/q supply the two-row descender-depth precedent.

glyphs.canonicalName: long hook
glyphs.notes: Move the native lowercase-f hook one column right to the dotless-i axis: row 3 pixels (5,3) and (6,3), then column 4 from row 4. Omit f’s unrelated crossbar. Continue the column-4 stave through row 14 and move the complete five-pixel dotless-i foot from row 13 to row 15; the straight descent has no baseline crossbar. Native p/q supply the two-row descender-depth precedent.

glyphs.canonicalName: tail
glyphs.notes: Retain the dotless-i head at (3,6) and (4,6). Continue the column-4 stave through row 13. Adapt dotless-j’s lower return to the common axis: row 14 columns 1 and 4, row 15 columns 2 and 3. Preserve the native left return and avoid a dot, crossbar, or column-0 ink.

glyphs.canonicalName: long tail
glyphs.notes: Use lowercase l’s two-pixel head at row 3 and its column-4 vertical. Continue the column-4 stave through row 13. Adapt dotless-j’s lower return to the common axis: row 14 columns 1 and 4, row 15 columns 2 and 3. Preserve the native left return and avoid a dot, crossbar, or column-0 ink.

glyphs.canonicalName: long spine
glyphs.notes: Move the native lowercase-f hook one column right to the dotless-i axis: row 3 pixels (5,3) and (6,3), then column 4 from row 4. Omit f’s unrelated crossbar. Continue the column-4 stave through row 13. Adapt dotless-j’s lower return to the common axis: row 14 columns 1 and 4, row 15 columns 2 and 3. Preserve the native left return and avoid a dot, crossbar, or column-0 ink.

Only explicitly recorded joining pixels change within rows 6–13. The native f upper hook uses row 3 columns 2–3 and column 1 in rows 4–5, with no crossbar, bulb, or extra serif. The left straight descender adds column 1, rows 14–15, following native p/q. Only the joining pixel (1,13) completes the straight stave through its native rounded baseline return. The right straight ascender adds column 6, rows 3–5, following native h/d. Only the joining pixel (6,6) completes the straight stave through its native rounded cap. The native j/eng lower hook uses (6,14), (4,15), and (5,15), with no upward free tip or accidental enclosure.

glyphs.canonicalName: two stems with spine and stem
glyphs.notes: Use a five-column shared body derived from the paired native a/turned-a cap and stave entrances, with two equal six-pixel counters and a compact two-row waist. The left shoulder enters below its crest; the right hip leaves above the baseline. Joined staves retain simple native n/m/u endings. Middle components follow allocation order from left to right; only their designated upper or lower extension pixels change between states. Outer curved terminals use the approved dense-family hook and simple eng return; no extra tip, serif, or enclosed terminal pocket is added. This allocation contains no declared long bowl or returnContact, so ordinary compact hooks are not forced to close against unrelated staves.

glyphs.canonicalName: two stems with spine and two stems
glyphs.notes: Use the approved four-stave body at columns 1, 3, 5, 7 with its row-9 crossover and two open central counters of two and three pixels. The left shoulder enters below its crest; the right hip leaves above the baseline. Joined staves retain simple native n/m/u endings. Middle components follow allocation order from left to right; only their designated upper or lower extension pixels change between states. Outer curved terminals use the approved dense-family hook and simple eng return; no extra tip, serif, or enclosed terminal pocket is added. This allocation contains no declared long bowl or returnContact, so ordinary compact hooks are not forced to close against unrelated staves.

The left shoulder enters below its crest; the right hip leaves above the baseline. Joined staves retain simple native n/m/u endings. Middle components follow allocation order from left to right; only their designated upper or lower extension pixels change between states. Outer curved terminals use the approved dense-family hook and simple eng return; no extra tip, serif, or enclosed terminal pocket is added. This allocation contains no declared long bowl or returnContact, so ordinary compact hooks are not forced to close against unrelated staves.
